Full suite via scripts/test_parallel.sh (N=8 partitions): combined 2981 tests, 6 properties, 2 failures (2985/2987 passed). Both failures are in Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest ('a mismatched rust pin reports a MISMATCH row...' and 'a matching rust pin reports OK with no mismatch...'), each raising ** (ErlangError) Erlang error: :enoent from System.cmd("rustc", ["--version"], ...) -- exactly the documented rustc/cargo-absent-from-PATH environmental flake for this sandbox, not a regression and unrelated to REQ-205. This TEST-RUNNER step's own handoff file is schema-compliant; the 6 sibling files from steps 02a/02c/02d/03/03b are pre-existing schema drift from earlier steps in this same run, flagged here for ORCH/RELEASE-VALIDATOR since TEST-RUNNER does not own those files and correcting them retroactively is out of scope for this step. RELEASE-VALIDATOR must weigh this gap when deciding whether REQ-205 is done.
